scientific_integrity: Direct analytic Zak and strict convexity proof; standalone numerical checks are corroborative, not a substitute for continuum verification. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unit translation spacing, the fixed rational Poisson window, and two unit-frequency cosets only; earlier equivalent Zak-fiber calculations in unindexed literature remain a priority risk.
title: Exact two-coset Poisson Gabor frame bounds and optimal frequency staggering
